title: "Creating and Managing a GitHub Repository"
description: "Step-by-step guide to creating a local Git repository, linking it to GitHub, and pushing changes."
format: html
---

This tutorial provides a step-by-step guide to creating a local Git repository and pushing it to your GitHub account. It covers initializing a project folder, linking it to a remote GitHub repository, and committing your files. You will also learn how to update your repository when changes are made locally. These commands are beginner-friendly and can be directly copied and executed in your terminal. By the end, you'll have your project successfully version-controlled and hosted on GitHub.

---


## Create a New Local Project

```bash
mkdir my_project                  # Create project folder
cd my_project                     # Navigate into folder
git init                          # Initialize Git
